thread_text:
Priya S.: Quick heads-up — i brought a foster bunny to the office for the afternoon! meet Mochi 🐰 photo drop in 2
Tom: AHHHHH cutest thing ever. pls post picture now :heart_eyes:
Priya S.: uploaded: <https://imgur.com/a/mochi-office|mochi_desk.png> — she immediately flopped onto a pile of sticky notes 
Lena: FLOP QUEEN. look at those ears 😭
Jorge: is there an official ban on rabbits hopping between desks? asking for keyboard safety reasons :grimacing:
People-Ops Bot: Reminder: office pets must be registered. Please ensure vaccinations are uploaded. If Mochi will be here >2 hours, file a short-term pet notice: https://intranet/pets
Priya S.: already pinged people-ops this morning and uploaded vax. Mochi is chill and chooses desks with sun only. no keyboard incidents yet :pray:
Tom: poll time: Mochi's ear mood — which category? 1) perky alert 2) dramatic flop 3) one-up/one-down 4) noodle ears. cast your votes (react with emoji) :ballot_box:
Lena: reacts with :one: and :two: — can't decide, both are valid aesthetic choices
Jorge: votes :three: — definitely one-up/one-down, that is her signature move
Priya S.: posted a short clip: <https://youtu.be/short_mochi_flop> — she does the slow blink and then a theatrical ear flop 
BunnyBot: Mochi registered as a guest pet. Friendly reminder: avoid feeding human snacks. Approved treats: rabbit pellets, small carrot pieces.
Tom: can someone bring a tiny soft blanket? Mochi is living for the heater vent vibes. volunteering to bring a miniature bunny beret if needed 
Lena: tiny beret would be iconic. also propose a Mochi sticker for the fridge. official merch? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Priya S.: LOL maybe a small sticker. for now, i put a sign on my desk: "Mochi zone — please knock before petting"
Jorge: sending boons: :seedling: donation jar for recommended hay & pellets? i can set up a little box by the kitchen
People-Ops Bot: Thanks for registering Mochi, Priya S.. If Mochi becomes a recurring visitor, please submit an ongoing pet registration form.
Tom: Mochi nap update: we have hourly photo drops. next one at 3:15. bring your camera phones :camera_with_flash:
